title: Who is better at math, Jenny or Jingzhen? Uncovering Stereotypes in Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper includes a significant component focused on religion as an axis of analysis for stereotypes in LLMs. It specifically identifies religion as the most influential feature for predicting ethnicity across models, provides detailed analyses of religious stereotypes (such as those involving Muslim, Jewish, and Hindu groups), and includes several tables (Tables 8, 9, 12, and 13) that map various religious descriptors to demographic groups as part of its benchmarking dataset.
